title: Koi Mil Gaya
desc: Rohit, a mentally challenged youth, befriends an alien. When police discover the creature, they try to capture it, while Rohit bravely protects his extraordinary friend against all odds.

title: Apne Paraye
desc: Wealthy Sidheshwari hands over household control to her sister-in-law Sheila, but peace is soon threatened when Harish arrives with his cunning wife Naintara, who plots to manipulate her.

title: Coolie No. 1
desc: A matchmaker tricks Raju, a coolie, into acting like a rich man so he can marry Hoshiyar Chand's daughter and teach her arrogant father a lesson in humility.

title: Saudagar
desc: Once warm friends, Veeru and Rajeshwar grow into bitter enemies. Years later, their long-buried feud resurfaces when their grandchildren fall in love, forcing the rivals to confront the past.

title: Indian
desc: Raj, a cop, captures terrorist Wasim Khan and earns praise from his father-in-law, a senior officer. But when he's mysteriously killed, Raj is accused of murder.

title: Apaharan
desc: Ajay, an aspiring cop, borrows money to chase his dream but fails to repay. Desperate, he joins a kidnapping plot, risking everything for a chance to escape debt.

title: Gangaajal
desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest cop, is posted to a crime-ridden town. He battles ruthless criminals, crooked officers, and shady politicians to restore law and justice.

title: Sankat City
desc: Guru is an automobile thief and Ganpat his partner. They steals a Mercedes belonging to Faujdar, a criminal don who loans people big money.

title: English Vinglish
desc: Shashi, a housewife and caterer, is mocked for not knowing English. Her journey to learn the language helps her rediscover herself and prove her worth as a mother and wife.

title: Humjoli
desc: Gopaldas marries heiress Roopa to get rich. His greed spirals out of control when he plots her murder to inherit her wealth.

title: Gambler
desc: Inspector Dayashanker, though lazy, accidentally uncovers a big criminal plot and suddenly becomes a hero in his department. But angry gangsters make his life a nightmare.

title: Saaransh
desc: A retired teacher and his wife struggle with grief after losing their only son to a tragic mugging. Slowly, they learn to find peace, holding on to memories and each other.

title: Ajay
desc: Ajay decent man from middleclass family,finds his whole family murdered.He decides to work for Rupesh,a criminal.While working with him,Ajay finds a clue leading him to the killer.

title: Gulaal
desc: Dilip, a law student from Rajpur, is assaulted by Jadhwal's gang. Seeking revenge, he becomes entangled in the dark and dangerous world of politics.

title: Race 3
desc: While executing their biggest heist, a criminal family uncovers shocking truths that put their relationships and loyalties to the ultimate test.

title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.
